# VLMPose

Text-Guided 6D Object Pose Rearrangement via Closed-Loop VLM Agents

**2026-04-10 · ECCV2026 (official repository) · Seoul National University**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09781)** · [Project](https://tlb-miss.github.io/vlmpose/) · [Code](https://github.com/snuvclab/vlmpose)

A VLM evaluator/proposer loop refines a target object’s 6D pose in a rendered scene, then a separate grasping/planning stack executes it.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/vlmpose-policy.webp" width="760" alt="Figure 2 : Our Method Overview. (a) We first ask the evaluator to assess how well the rendered multi-view images satisfy the input text instruction. If the current scene is judged inconsistent with the instruction, we provide the proposer with the supporting view, augmented with coordinate system visualization, that best explains the evaluator’s judgment. Based on this input, the proposer predicts an incremental 6D pose update. The predicted update is then applied to the target object, and this "/>

**Scope and qualifications**

- The agent loop edits/render-checks object goal poses; it does not directly close the physical robot motor-feedback loop.
- SIMPLER results are simulated, despite real-hardware-inspired configuration.
- Initial metric RGB-D/meshes are required; no claim of monocular metric reconstruction.
